name: structure-based-discovery
reference_policy: agents must not look up the source publication to copy hit lists or scores

grading.method: pass-bar anchored; scripts/grade_run.py checks expected output files and metrics.json
grading.note: docking kcal/mol anchors are engine-relative (paper engine vs platform Vina/Diffdock); see each task's engine note

tasks.title: Task 001 — Integrated pharmacophore and docking screen for EGFR inhibitors across commercial databases
tasks.pass_bar: ≥1 hit out-docking R85/known inhibitors with acceptable ADMET (QikProp ranges: QPlogHERG < −5, QPlogPo/w −2.0 to 6.5, QPlogBB −3.0 to 1.2, QPlogKhsa −1.5 to 1.5; MW < 500).

evaluation_metrics.published_value: R85 −7.18, osimertinib −6.94, afatinib −6.41, gefitinib −6.25, erlotinib −5.60 kcal/mol
200 ns; stable RMSD/RMSF for all three

tasks.title: Task 002 — Pharmacophore-aided virtual screening for TrkB agonists against CDKL5-deficiency disorders
tasks.disease: CDKL5-deficiency disorder (rare neurodevelopmental disorder; early epilepsy)
tasks.pass_bar: ≥1 candidate docking better than 7,8-DHF (−7.1 kcal/mol; published hits reach −9.6) with High GI absorption and an acceptable ADMET profile.

evaluation_metrics.published_value: All 6 hits: High GI absorption, BBB non-permeant, ESOL/Ali soluble (Silicos-IT poorly soluble); consensus LogP 1.95–2.41; TPSA 107.8–127.77 Å; SA 3.88–4.12; 7,8-DHF inhibits CYP1A2/2D6/3A4 vs hits inhibiting ≤1 CYP
Ligand RMSD comp 1 0.2–0.8 Å / comp 2 0.6–1.8 Å (backbone drifts to ~5.3 Å in both); PCA PC1–3: 69.5% (comp 1) / 79.3% (comp 2); H-bonds 6 (comp 1) / 10 (comp 2)

P-gp text self-contradicts (calls both compound groups "potential substrates"; Table 4 marks only 1/3/6 as substrates); compound-1 H-bond text cites "Figure 9", which is compound 2's graph; Table 1 also duplicates one acceptor row

tasks.title: Task 003 — Structure-based discovery of MMP-9 inhibitors for cerebral ischemia by pharmacophore screening, docking, ADMET profiling and 200 ns MD

tasks.title: Task: hkii_antidengue_virtual_screening
tasks.disease: Dengue; computational prioritisation for a host-directed therapeutic strategy\
tasks.pass_bar: All 3 query groups must have an auditable screening, filtering, docking and candidate-selection outcome, with justified reference comparisons and reconciled artifacts. Complete dynamics validation for every selected candidate and matched reference before claiming a complete candidate-validation workflow. If no candidate qualifies in a group, report that scientific outcome explicitly rather than inventing a candidate or claiming its simulation ran. An unsupported or unexecuted required capability leaves the run PARTIAL or NEEDS_INPUT.

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Validated identities, chemical states, library size, exclusions and retained input artifacts
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Every reported candidate and reference must map to a documented input; identity-changing transformations must be explicit

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Counts and rankings by query group, three-dimensional shape/feature evidence, conformer handling and filter attrition
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Reconcile entry counts and unique identities separately, preserve the requested screening method and explain exclusions; do not force a predetermined retained yield

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Compound-level properties, endpoint coverage, model identities, units and declared selection rules
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Establish endpoint coverage from model definitions rather than names alone; missing predictions remain unresolved and predictions must support the actual selection decisions

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Effective region, coordinate-frame checks, reference poses, available recovery metrics and contemporaneous reference results
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Binding claims require a valid region and interpretable controls; score agreement alone does not establish pose recovery

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Finalists, reference-relative comparisons and supporting pose/property evidence
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Compare compatible methods and protocols; do not treat scores from different models as interchangeable or equate a score with measured affinity

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Completed equilibration/production duration, analysed systems, atom selections, alignment, units and time-series summaries
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Verify 100 ps equilibration and 20 ns production from logs and trajectories per selected candidate/reference system; missing requested systems or incomplete trajectories leave the validation stage incomplete

evaluation_metrics.measurements_and_evidence: Stage outcomes, job records, artifact availability, exclusions and limitations
evaluation_metrics.evaluation_rule: Classify the run from executed evidence; unavailable required stages prevent a complete-workflow claim
